variants.name: 原神参考方向
variants.prompt:
Create a NEW character style study, not a minor repaint or filter of the previous outputs. User wants the official modern Chinese anime gacha character illustration language of Genshin Impact / Wuthering Waves, and explicitly rejected BOTH Western painterly realism AND the old-fashioned flat lined muscular anime examples. Study the PROVIDED GAME STYLE REFERENCE images as the dominant guide to drawing, proportions, facial design, color, and shading.
Output: one wide comparison sheet with two tall grey-brown stone framed hero cards, left the original red-haired male commander, right the original blonde sun-crowned female lancer. Both portrayed large from head to mid-thigh, nearly filling the entire inner frame. The crown, a few hair locks and weapon may overlap the frame in a carefully designed foreground layer, with intact full surrounding canvas margin. Plain charcoal background, no setting, no labels, text, logo, UI statistics, particles, or surrounding spell effects.
The project character references establish identity ONLY: male red hair, cobalt cloth, gold armor, broad curved sword; female blonde hair, sun crown, ivory-purple cloth, gold armor, spear. Keep those cues but REINTERPRET shapes and material design in the game style reference. You may simplify the costume construction. Build a few large readable costume masses and intentional ornate accents, not a surface covered with tiny metal shards.
Faces: unmistakably modern premium anime game faces, clean contour, stylized eyes with fine designed lashes/upper eyelid, tiny clean nose indication, economical facial shading, natural small mouth. Clear attractive adult character design. Male is a self-possessed competent commander, confident angular brow, compact well-proportioned midface and lower face, neck and torso athletically grounded; masculine character without a long pointed chin, baby face, fashion-doll weakness, thick Western comic jaw or bodybuilder bulk. Do NOT rely on beard, stubble, wrinkles or realistic skin to make him mature: make him clean-shaven. Female is a beautiful elegant adult anime heroine with lively irises and assured expression, not a blank doll or realistic model.
Rendering: fine colored linework selectively merging into shading, clean cel-organized shadow structure COMBINED WITH controlled smooth color gradients and subtle ambient/rim light, polished nuanced hair clumps and highlights, clear separation of fabric/matte leather/metal. No thick black ink outlines; no oil strokes, gritty brush texture, pores, 3D sculptural PBR lighting, mirror-metal glare, cheap plastic gloss or angular faceted brush daubs. Shading is neither hyperreal nor crude flat cartoon. Focus of highest detail and contrast is the face and upper torso, not endless armor engraving.
Stone frame remains the understated approved frame family; DON'T force the character art into realistic brown/sepia merely to match its material. Color inside the card must stay clean, cool/warm balanced and luminous. Frame integration is composition, not a brown filter. Return a finished premium 2D character illustration mockup.
Input roles: Image 1 is a HoYoLAB community comparison containing official Genshin Impact Navia and Zhongli character art, used ONLY as STYLE reference; don't copy their faces/clothes, logos, parasol, or names. Images 2 and 3 are project character IDENTITY references, NOT style references. Image 4 is the stone frame. Prioritize Image 1's clean bright anime eye/nose proportions, tidy cel-shaped color separation plus soft high-quality gradient modeling, economical specular accents, readable costume shapes and attractive heroic presentation. Restore that crisp modern Genshin Impact character-art feeling in OUR distinct red-haired commander and blonde sun-lancer. The male should look mature via composure and sharp eye design, without old-man facial features.

Generated images are saved to /Users/qingshi/.codex/generated_images/01a0e87a-7adc-7212-810f-f9bef1fe2ac1 as /Users/qingshi/.codex/generated_images/01a0e87a-7adc-7212-810f-f9bef1fe2ac1/exec-f27fdb31-ed74-4a75-86e9-f09ee0b38612.png by default.
If you need to use a generated image at another path, copy it and leave the original in place unless the user explicitly asks you to delete it.
The generated image is already displayed to the user. There is no need to render it in the final response as a Markdown image or file link.
